Subject: MAP checkpoint / next steps for expansion

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the team was impressed with the latency and the batching options. We're preparing our internal plan to extend Redwood to two more product teams (Clinical Ops and Patient Insights) and would like to lock down a MAP and timeline so Procurement can start the sourcing process.

Two immediate asks from our side:
- Updated MAP spreadsheet reflecting the proposed seat/licensing ramp (current usage: 480k tokens/day; target end of Q1: 1.6M tokens/day)
- A brief evaluation plan for bench testing with Clinical Ops (3-week technical validation)

Can we do a weekly 30-minute checkpoint next Tuesday to review the updated MAP and outstanding procurement questions? Please include any owners and deliverables.

Lisa Gordon
Director, Platform Partnerships
Novum Health
